ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF.summary: The global register of Legal Entity Identifiers: about 3.4 million companies, funds and other organizations worldwide, with their names, addresses, home registries and corporate events.
ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF.row: One legal entity: one company, fund or other organization that holds a global LEI code.

cols.REGISTRATION_INITIALREGISTRATIONDATE: When this record was first registered in the global company ID system. Date with time in one table, date only in the other.
cols.REGISTRATION_LASTUPDATEDATE: When this record was last updated in the global company ID system. Date with time in one table, date only in the other.
cols.REGISTRATION_REGISTRATIONSTATUS: Whether the record is current, in words like ISSUED, PUBLISHED, LAPSED, RETIRED or ANNULLED. LAPSED means the yearly renewal was missed.
cols.REGISTRATION_NEXTRENEWALDATE: When the record is due for its yearly renewal. Date with time in one table, date only in the other.
cols.REGISTRATION_MANAGINGLOU: The 20-character ID of the registration office that manages this record, like 529900T8BM49AURSDO55.
cols.REGISTRATION_VALIDATIONSOURCES: How well the record was checked against outside sources: FULLY_CORROBORATED, PARTIALLY_CORROBORATED or ENTITY_SUPPLIED_ONLY.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_STARTNODE_NODEID: The legal entity ID of the child side of the link: the fund, subsidiary or branch.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_STARTNODE_NODEIDTYPE: What kind of ID the child side uses. Always LEI.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_ENDNODE_NODEID: The legal entity ID of the parent side of the link: the owner, fund manager or head office.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_ENDNODE_NODEIDTYPE: What kind of ID the parent side uses. Always LEI.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_RELATIONSHIPTYPE: The kind of tie, like IS_FUND-MANAGED_BY, IS_ULTIMATELY_CONSOLIDATED_BY, IS_DIRECTLY_CONSOLIDATED_BY, IS_SUBFUND_OF or IS_INTERNATIONAL_BRANCH_OF.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_RELATIONSHIPSTATUS: ACTIVE or INACTIVE. Almost every link is ACTIVE.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_1_STARTDATE: Start date of the first period on file for this link.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_1_ENDDATE: End date of the first period on file. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_1_PERIODTYPE: What the first period means: RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD or DOCUMENT_FILING_PERIOD.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_2_STARTDATE: Start date of the second period on file for this link. Blank for about four in ten links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_2_ENDDATE: End date of the second period on file. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_2_PERIODTYPE: What the second period means: RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD or DOCUMENT_FILING_PERIOD.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_3_STARTDATE: Start date of the third period on file. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_3_ENDDATE: End date of the third period on file. Blank for almost every link.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_PERIOD_3_PERIODTYPE: What the third period means, mostly DOCUMENT_FILING_PERIOD. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUALIFIERS_1_QUALIFIERDIMEN: What the qualifier is about. Always ACCOUNTING_STANDARD when filled; blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUALIFIERS_1_QUALIFIERCATEG: The accounting rules behind the link, like IFRS, US_GAAP or OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUALIFIERS_2_QUALIFIERDIMEN: A second qualifier topic, always ACCOUNTING_STANDARD. Filled on only 39 links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUALIFIERS_2_QUALIFIERCATEG: A second accounting standard, like IFRS or US_GAAP. Filled on only 39 links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUANTIFIERS_1_MEASUREMENTME: How the ownership share was measured. Always ACCOUNTING_CONSOLIDATION when filled; blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUANTIFIERS_1_QUANTIFIERAMO: The ownership share, mostly 100. Blank for most links.
cols.RELATIONSHIP_QUANTIFIERS_1_QUANTIFIERUNI: The unit of the ownership share. Always PERCENTAGE when filled; blank for most links.
cols.REGISTRATION_VALIDATIONDOCUMENTS: What kind of document backs up the link, like SUPPORTING_DOCUMENTS, ACCOUNTS_FILING or REGULATORY_FILING.
cols.REGISTRATION_VALIDATIONREFERENCE: Where to find that backing document, often a web link or a note that it is not public. Blank for most links.

ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF_RELATIONSHIPS.summary: Ownership and control links between companies and funds worldwide, from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation: who is consolidated by whom, which fund is managed by whom, which branch belongs to whom.
ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF_RELATIONSHIPS.row: One link: one entity tied to a parent, manager or head office, with the kind of tie.

cols.LEI: The company's Legal Entity Identifier, a 20-character global ID. The FDIC table's values are only 16 characters, so they look cut short.
cols.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY: Which parent is not reported: the direct parent or the ultimate parent.
cols.EXCEPTION_REASON_1: The main reason given, as a code like NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON or NO_LEI.
cols.EXCEPTION_REASON_2: A second reason, when given. Filled on under 1% of rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REASON_3: A third reason, when given. Filled on 764 rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REASON_4: A fourth reason, when given. Filled on 40 rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REASON_5: A fifth reason, when given. Filled on 6 rows, all BINDING_LEGAL_COMMITMENTS.
cols.EXCEPTION_REFERENCE_1: A free-text note on the exception, often just repeating the reason. Mostly blank.
cols.EXCEPTION_REFERENCE_2: A second free-text note, sometimes naming a company. Filled on 16 rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REFERENCE_3: A third free-text note. Filled on 4 rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REFERENCE_4: A fourth free-text note. Filled on 4 rows.
cols.EXCEPTION_REFERENCE_5: Meant for a fifth free-text note. Empty in this table.

ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF_REPEX.summary: Reasons companies with a global Legal Entity Identifier gave for not naming their parent company, from GLEIF's reporting-exceptions file.
ECONOMICS__INTL_GLEIF_REPEX.row: One exception: one company's reason for not reporting its direct or ultimate parent.

cols.COUNTRY: The country, written different ways by table: a full name, a two- or three-letter code, or a number code that needs a lookup. Some rows hold a region like World or a UK nation like England, and two tables leave it empty.
cols.DATE_OF_ANALYSIS: Month the analysis was done, as text like Nov 2025.
cols.TOTAL_COUNTRY_POPULATION: The country's total population, stored as text. 0 is a placeholder on some rows.
cols.VALIDITY_PERIOD: Whether the numbers are current, a first projection, or a second projection.
cols.C_FROM: Start date of the period the numbers cover, stored as text.
cols.C_TO: End date of the period the numbers cover, stored as text.
cols.PHASE: Severity phase: 1 to 5, 3+ for phase 3 and worse, or all for everyone analyzed. The phase meanings need a lookup.
cols.NUMBER: People in this phase, stored as text.
cols.PERCENTAGE: Share of the analyzed population in this phase, as a fraction like 0.16, stored as text; 1.0 on the all rows.

ECONOMICS__INTL_IPC_FOOD_INSECURITY_GLOB.summary: How many people in each country face food crisis, by severity phase, from IPC food security analyses done in 2025 and 2026.
ECONOMICS__INTL_IPC_FOOD_INSECURITY_GLOB.row: One country, one analysis period, one severity phase: how many people fall in that phase.

cols.COUNTRY: The country, written different ways by table: a full name, a two- or three-letter code, or a number code that needs a lookup. Some rows hold a region like World or a UK nation like England, and two tables leave it empty.
cols.DATAFLOW_ID: The ID of the statistics dataset this row comes from, like 101_1015 or TESPN070.
cols.OBS_VALUE: The number measured for this row. Units depend on the dataset; stored as text in the Eurostat table.
cols.OBS_STATUS: A lowercase letter noting something about the value, like c or u; needs a lookup. Almost always blank.
cols.FREQ: How often the number is measured: A for yearly, M for monthly.
cols._INGESTED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store a long number counting microseconds since 1970, and a few hold broken dates with impossible years like 56645445. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.ISTAT_OBS_ID: A made-up ID for the row. Nearly every row has its own. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.DATE: The date the number is for. Yearly numbers show as January 1.
cols.DIMENSION_KEYS: The series' codes joined by dots, like A.BEANK.ALL.ITE4.HP_Q_EXT, naming what, where and how it is measured. The codes need a lookup.
cols.SERIES_KEY: The same codes in a different order, joined by colons, naming one series. The codes need a lookup.
cols.OBS_YEAR: The year of the number, 2020 to 2023.
cols.OBS_MONTH: The month of the number. Yearly numbers show 1.
cols.OBS_QUARTER: The quarter of the number. Yearly numbers show 1.
cols.UNIT_MEASURE: The unit of the number. Empty.
cols.UNIT_MULT: The power of ten the number is scaled by. Empty.
cols.UNIT_MULTIPLIER_VALUE: The scale factor for the number. Empty.
cols.OBS_VALUE_ABSOLUTE: The number without its sign. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.IS_NORMAL_VALUE: A normal-value flag. False on every row, so it tells you nothing. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.IS_MISSING_VALUE: True when the number is missing. True on 244 rows. Added by your pipeline, not the source.

ECONOMICS__INTL_IT_ISTAT.summary: Official Italian statistics from Istat, Italy's national statistics office, on the economy, jobs, trade, farming and population, mostly 2020 to 2023.
ECONOMICS__INTL_IT_ISTAT.row: One number: one statistic for one series in one year or month.

cols.ENTITY: The country or region name, like Albania or World.
cols.YEAR: The year the row covers, like 2021. A few tables use a range like 2020-2022, and three tables leave it empty.
cols.WORLD_REGION_ACCORDING_TO_OWID: The continent the country belongs to, as Our World in Data groups them, like Europe or Africa.
cols.CODE: The three-letter country code, like USA or GBR. Blank for regions and groupings.
cols.GINI_COEFFICIENT: The country's inequality score from 0 to 1. Higher means more unequal. Stored as text.

ECONOMICS__XC_OWID_GINI.summary: How unequal incomes are in each country, year by year, as measured by the Gini coefficient and published by Our World in Data.
ECONOMICS__XC_OWID_GINI.row: One country-year: one country's income inequality score for one year.

cols.RANK: The row's place in a ranked list, where 1 is first. Empty in the USGS minerals table.
cols.NAME: The name of whatever the row is about: a person, company, bank, county, address or dataset, depending on the table. Spelling is not cleaned, fillers like UNNAMED or None show up, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.INDUSTRY: The company's industry, like Financials or Retail.
cols.REVENUE_USD_MILLIONS: Yearly revenue in millions of dollars.
cols.REVENUE_GROWTH: Revenue growth from the year before, as text with a percent sign, like 6.2%.
cols.EMPLOYEES: How many people the company employs.
cols.HEADQUARTERS: The city and state of the company's headquarters, like Houston, Texas.

ECONOMICS__XC_WIKIPEDIA_LARGEST_US_COMPA.summary: The 100 largest US companies by revenue, as listed on Wikipedia.
ECONOMICS__XC_WIKIPEDIA_LARGEST_US_COMPA.row: One company: its industry, revenue, growth, workforce and headquarters.

cols.MARKET_AND_EXCHANGE_NAMES: The futures market and the exchange it trades on, like WHEAT - CHICAGO BOARD OF TRADE.
cols.AS_OF_DATE_IN_FORM_YYMMDD: The date the weekly trader positions were counted, a Tuesday. Stored as a real date despite the name.
cols.CFTC_CONTRACT_MARKET_CODE: The exchange's code for one futures market, usually 6 characters and sometimes with a letter or a + sign. Two of the tables pad it with a trailing space, so trim before joining.
cols.CFTC_MARKET_CODE: The exchange the futures contract trades on, as a short code like CME or CBT. Values carry trailing spaces.
cols.CFTC_REGION_CODE: The CFTC's region code, 00 or 01; what each means needs a lookup.
cols.CFTC_COMMODITY_CODE: The CFTC's 3-digit code for the commodity, like 064 or 138.
cols.OPEN_INTEREST_ALL: The total number of futures contracts still open that week.
cols.DEALER_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.DEALER_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.DEALER_POSITIONS_SPREAD_ALL: How many futures contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, held on both sides at once, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.ASSET_MGR_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.ASSET_MGR_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.ASSET_MGR_POSITIONS_SPREAD_ALL: How many futures contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, held on both sides at once, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.LEV_MONEY_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts leveraged funds, meaning hedge funds held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.LEV_MONEY_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts leveraged funds, meaning hedge funds held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.LEV_MONEY_POSITIONS_SPREAD_ALL: How many futures contracts leveraged funds, meaning hedge funds held, held on both sides at once, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.OTHER_REPT_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts other large traders held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.OTHER_REPT_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts other large traders held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.OTHER_REPT_POSITIONS_SPREAD_ALL: How many futures contracts other large traders held, held on both sides at once, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.TOT_REPT_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts all large traders who must report held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.TOT_REPT_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts all large traders who must report held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.NONREPT_POSITIONS_LONG_ALL: How many futures contracts small traders below the reporting line held, betting the price rises, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.NONREPT_POSITIONS_SHORT_ALL: How many futures contracts small traders below the reporting line held, betting the price falls, in the report week. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_OPEN_INTEREST_ALL: How much open interest rose or fell since the week before; can be negative. A lone period shows up as filler.
cols.CHANGE_IN_DEALER_LONG_ALL: How much the contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, betting the price rises, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_DEALER_SHORT_ALL: How much the contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, betting the price falls, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_DEALER_SPREAD_ALL: How much the contracts dealers, meaning big banks held, held on both sides at once, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_ASSET_MGR_LONG_ALL: How much the contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, betting the price rises, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_ASSET_MGR_SHORT_ALL: How much the contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, betting the price falls, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.
cols.CHANGE_IN_ASSET_MGR_SPREAD_ALL: How much the contracts asset managers like pension and mutual funds held, held on both sides at once, changed since the prior week; can be negative. A lone dot means no number. Stored as text with leading spaces.

EDUCATION__FED_CFTC_COT_FINANCIAL.summary: The CFTC's weekly Commitments of Traders report for financial futures, showing how many contracts dealers, asset managers, hedge funds and other traders hold long and short in each market.
EDUCATION__FED_CFTC_COT_FINANCIAL.row: One market in one week: the positions held in one financial futures market on one report date.

cols.INSTITUTION_NAME: The name of the college, bank, or financial firm. Some FDIC rows say Redacted.
cols.CITY: The city or town name, in capitals or mixed case, with spellings not cleaned. Some rows hold fillers like UNKNOWN or TBD, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.STATE: The state, usually as two letters like TX, but some tables spell out the name like Texas or United States. A few hold junk like active or a region name, and some leave it empty.
cols.ZIP: The ZIP code, stored as text, as 5 digits or 9 with or without a dash. Fillers like 00000, UNKNO or a lone dash show up, some codes lost a leading zero like 8721, and three tables leave it empty.
cols.STATE_FIPS: The state's number code, like 48 or 06, which needs a lookup. Several tables drop the leading zero so 6 means 06, some rows hold other codes like C1, TX, 00 or N/A, and three tables leave it empty.
cols.REGION_CODE: A region of the country as a number code. BJS uses 1 to 4 plus -1, and the college table uses a longer list. Needs each source's lookup.
cols.LATITUDE: How far north the place is, usually in decimal degrees. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 481243N, and several tables leave it empty.
cols.LONGITUDE: How far east or west the place is, usually in decimal degrees; U.S. places are negative. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 0955859W, and several tables leave it empty.
cols._LOADED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store it as a long number counting microseconds since 1970. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SRC_SHA256: A fingerprint of the source file this row came from, used to spot a changed file. Some tables hold the placeholder "streamed-see-source-zip" or leave it empty. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.UNITID: The Education Department's ID number for the college. Each row has its own.
cols.OPEID: The college's eight-digit ID for federal student aid, kept as text to hold leading zeros. A few are blank.
cols.OPEID6: The first six digits of the student-aid ID. Branch campuses of one school share it.
cols.NET_PRICE_CALCULATOR_URL: A link to the college's calculator for estimating what a student will pay.
cols.ACCREDITING_AGENCY: The group that accredits the college, like the Higher Learning Commission.
cols.IS_MAIN_CAMPUS: 1 if this is the main campus, 0 if it is a branch.
cols.BRANCH_COUNT: How many campuses the college has, counting this one.
cols.CURRENTLY_OPERATING: 1 if the college is still open, 0 if it has closed.
cols.LOCALE_CODE: A two-digit code for city, suburb, town or rural setting, like 21 or 11. The codes need a lookup.
cols.CONTROL_CODE: Who runs the college, as 1, 2 or 3, like public or private. The codes need a lookup.
cols.INSTITUTION_LEVEL_CODE: The college's level as 1, 2 or 3, like four-year or two-year. The codes need a lookup.
cols.PREDOMINANT_DEGREE_CODE: The kind of award most students earn, as 0 to 4. The codes need a lookup.
cols.HIGHEST_DEGREE_CODE: The highest award the college gives, as 0 to 4. The codes need a lookup.
cols.CARNEGIE_BASIC_CODE: The college's Carnegie type, a number code. -2 is the most common value and looks like a not-applicable marker; the codes need a lookup.
cols.IS_HBCU: 1 if the college is a historically Black college or university, 0 if not.
cols.IS_PBI: 1 if the college is a predominantly Black institution, 0 if not.
cols.IS_TRIBAL: 1 if the college is a tribal college, 0 if not.
cols.IS_HSI: 1 if the college is a Hispanic-serving institution, 0 if not.
cols.IS_MEN_ONLY: 1 if the college admits only men, 0 if not.
cols.IS_WOMEN_ONLY: 1 if the college admits only women, 0 if not.
cols.RELIGIOUS_AFFILIATION_CODE: A number code for the college's religious tie. Blank for most colleges; the codes need a lookup.
cols.IS_DISTANCE_ONLY: 1 if the college teaches only online or at a distance, 0 if not.
cols.ADMISSION_RATE: The share of applicants admitted at this campus, from 0 to 1. Blank for most colleges.
cols.ADMISSION_RATE_ALL_CAMPUSES: The share of applicants admitted across all of the college's campuses, from 0 to 1. Blank for most colleges.
cols.SAT_AVG: The average SAT score of admitted students. Blank for most colleges.
cols.ACT_COMPOSITE_MIDPOINT: The middle ACT score of admitted students. Blank for most colleges.
cols.NET_PRICE_PUBLIC: The average yearly cost after grants for students at a public college, in dollars. Blank for most colleges.
cols.NET_PRICE_PRIVATE: The average yearly cost after grants for students at a private college, in dollars.
cols.COST_OF_ATTENDANCE_ACADEMIC_YEAR: The full yearly cost to attend, in dollars, for schools that run on an academic year. Blank for about half.
cols.COST_OF_ATTENDANCE_PROGRAM_YEAR: The full cost to attend, in dollars, for schools priced by program. Blank for most colleges.
cols.TUITION_IN_STATE: Yearly tuition and fees for in-state students, in dollars.
cols.TUITION_OUT_OF_STATE: Yearly tuition and fees for out-of-state students, in dollars.
cols.TUITION_PROGRAM_YEAR: Tuition and fees for schools priced by program, in dollars. Blank for most colleges.
cols.TUITION_REVENUE_PER_FTE: Tuition money the college takes in per full-time student, in dollars.
cols.INSTRUCTIONAL_SPEND_PER_FTE: What the college spends on teaching per full-time student, in dollars.
cols.AVG_FACULTY_SALARY_MONTHLY: The average monthly pay of teaching staff, in dollars.
cols.PCT_FULL_TIME_FACULTY: The share of teaching staff who are full-time, from 0 to 1.
cols.PCT_PELL: The share of undergraduates getting a Pell grant for low-income students, from 0 to 1.
cols.PCT_FEDERAL_LOAN: The share of undergraduates taking a federal student loan, from 0 to 1.
cols.COMPLETION_RATE_150PCT_4YR: The share of students at four-year colleges who finish within six years, from 0 to 1. Blank for most colleges.
cols.COMPLETION_RATE_150PCT_LT4YR: The share of students at shorter-program colleges who finish within one and a half times the normal time, from 0 to 1. Blank for more than half.
cols.RETENTION_FULL_TIME_4YR: The share of full-time first-year students at four-year colleges who come back the next year, from 0 to 1. Blank for most colleges.
cols.RETENTION_FULL_TIME_LT4YR: The share of full-time first-year students at shorter-program colleges who come back or finish, from 0 to 1. Blank for more than half.
cols.DEFAULT_RATE_2YR: The share of former students who defaulted on federal loans within two years, from 0 to 1.
cols.DEFAULT_RATE_3YR: The share of former students who defaulted on federal loans within three years. Almost all values are 0, so this column looks unusable.
cols.REPAYMENT_RATE_3YR: The share of former students paying down their loans three years out, from 0 to 1.
cols.DEBT_MEDIAN: The middle amount of federal loan debt students leave with, in dollars.
cols.DEBT_MEDIAN_COMPLETERS: The middle loan debt of students who graduated, in dollars.
cols.DEBT_MEDIAN_WITHDRAWN: The middle loan debt of students who dropped out, in dollars.
cols.EARNINGS_MEDIAN_6YR: The middle yearly earnings of former students six years after starting, in dollars.
cols.EARNINGS_MEDIAN_8YR: The middle yearly earnings of former students eight years after starting, in dollars.
cols.EARNINGS_MEDIAN_10YR: The middle yearly earnings of former students ten years after starting, in dollars.
cols.EARNINGS_MEAN_10YR: The average yearly earnings of former students ten years after starting, in dollars, rounded to the hundred.

cols.FILING_UUID: The Senate's long unique ID for one lobbying filing.
cols.FILING_YEAR: The year the filing covers, like 2021, stored as text.
cols.DT_POSTED: When the lobbying filing was posted, as a text date and time with a time zone.
cols.REGISTRANT_ID: The Senate's number for the lobbying firm or group that filed. Stored as text.
cols.REGISTRANT_NAME: The name of whoever registered, like a lobbying firm, fund, foreign agent, aircraft owner or offender, with people often last name first. The aircraft table also uses REGISTRATION PENDING as a filler.
cols.CLIENT_ID: The Senate's number for the client the lobbying was done for. Stored as text.
cols.CLIENT_NAME: The name of the client the lobbying was done for, like COMCAST CORPORATION.
cols.TERMINATION_DATE: The date the thing ended, like a registration, recall or judge's service, and blank when it has not ended. Some rows hold far-future dates like 2101-01-04 or 2200-12-30.

cols.FILING_PERIOD: The period covered, like first_quarter or mid_year.
cols.FILING_PERIOD_DISPLAY: The period covered in words with dates, like 1st Quarter, Jan 1 - Mar 31.
cols.INCOME: What the lobbying firm was paid by the client for the period, in dollars. Stored as text. Blank on about 40% of filings, including those that report expenses instead.
cols.EXPENSES: What a group spent lobbying for itself in the period, in dollars. Mostly blank; stored as text.
cols.REGISTRANT_DESCRIPTION: How the lobbying firm or group describes itself, like Law firm, spelled many ways.
cols.REGISTRANT_CITY: The lobbying firm's city, mostly Washington, with mixed casing.
cols.REGISTRANT_STATE: The lobbying firm's state, as two letters.
cols.REGISTRANT_COUNTRY: The lobbying firm's country, as two letters. Almost all US.
cols.CLIENT_DESCRIPTION: What the client does, in its own words, like Manufacturing or Municipality.
cols.CLIENT_STATE: The client's state, as two letters.
cols.CLIENT_COUNTRY: The client's country, as two letters. Almost all US.
cols.LOBBYING_ISSUES: The broad issue areas lobbied on, like Health Issues or Defense.
cols.GOVERNMENT_ENTITIES: The parts of government lobbied, like HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES and SENATE, joined with a bar.
cols.LOBBYIST_NAMES: The names of the individual lobbyists. Empty in this table.
cols.SPECIFIC_ISSUES: Free text on the exact bills and topics lobbied on.
cols.FOREIGN_ENTITY_LISTED: True when the filing lists a foreign company or government with a stake in the lobbying.

cols.PRIMARY_PURPOSE_NAICS_CODE: An industry code for the plant owner's main business. 22 means utilities, which is most plants; others need a lookup.
cols.REGULATORY_STATUS: RE for a rate-regulated utility plant, NR for not regulated. Most are NR.
cols.SECTOR: A number code, 1 to 7, for the kind of owner, like utility or independent producer. The codes need a lookup.
cols.FERC_COGENERATION_STATUS: Y when the plant is federally certified as making both power and useful heat.

cols.FERC_SMALL_POWER_PRODUCER_STATUS: Y when the plant is federally certified as a small power producer.

cols.FERC_EXEMPT_WHOLESALE_GENERATOR_STATUS: Y when the plant is a federally exempt wholesale power seller.

cols.ASH_IMPOUNDMENT: Y when the plant has a pond for coal ash or other burn waste. Rare.
cols.ASH_IMPOUNDMENT_LINED: Whether the ash pond has a liner: Y, N, or X. X fills most rows; its meaning needs a lookup.
cols.ASH_IMPOUNDMENT_STATUS: A two-letter status for the ash pond, like OP or OS. Filled for only a few hundred plants. The codes need a lookup.
cols.TRANSMISSION_OR_DISTRIBUTION_SYSTEM_OWNE: The utility that owns the power lines the plant feeds into, like Southern California Edison.

cols.GRID_VOLTAGE_3_KV: A third grid connection voltage, in kilovolts. Blank for almost every plant.
cols.ENERGY_STORAGE: Y when the plant stores energy, like with batteries.
cols.NATURAL_GAS_LDC_NAME: The local gas utility that delivers gas to the plant. Blank for most plants.
cols.NATURAL_GAS_PIPELINE_NAME_1: The main gas pipeline serving the plant. Blank for most plants.
cols.NATURAL_GAS_PIPELINE_NAME_2: A second gas pipeline serving the plant. Blank for almost every plant.
cols.NATURAL_GAS_PIPELINE_NAME_3: A third gas pipeline serving the plant. Blank for almost every plant.
cols.PIPELINE_NOTES: Free-text notes about the plant's gas supply. Blank for almost every plant.
cols.NATURAL_GAS_STORAGE: Whether the plant stores natural gas on site: Y, N or X. X means the question does not apply to it. Blank for about half.
cols.LIQUEFIED_NATURAL_GAS_STORAGE: Whether the plant stores liquefied natural gas on site: Y, N or X. Blank for about half.

cols.PLANT_CODE: The Energy Department's ID number for the power plant. Use it to join the plant, generator, and owner tables.
cols.GENERATOR_ID: The generator's short ID inside its power plant, like GT4 or 1. Only unique together with the plant code.
cols.UTILITY_ID: The Energy Department's ID number for the utility.
cols.UTILITY_NAME: The name of the power company, utility or other plant operator, like Georgia Power Co or Walmart Stores. Some rows hold a filler like Adjustment 2024 instead of a real company.
cols.PLANT_NAME: The name of the power plant.
cols.STATE: The state, usually as two letters like TX, but some tables spell out the name like Texas or United States. A few hold junk like active or a region name, and some leave it empty.
cols.COUNTY: The county, usually as a name like Harris, though some tables add the word County and the federal court tables use five-digit number codes, including 88888, which needs a lookup. The UK company table holds UK counties, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.TECHNOLOGY: The kind of power generator, in words, like Onshore Wind Turbine or Solar Photovoltaic.
cols.PRIME_MOVER: A two-letter code for the machine that turns the generator, like WT for wind turbine or PV for solar panels. Needs a lookup for the rest.
cols.OWNERSHIP: What kind of owner the utility is, like Cooperative, Municipal, or Investor Owned. The generator table uses one-letter codes: S, J, or W.
cols.SECTOR_NAME: What kind of company runs the power plant, like Electric Utility, or IPP for an independent power producer. CHP means it also makes heat.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_1: The main fuel the generator burns, as a short code like NG for natural gas, WND for wind or NUC for nuclear; needs a lookup.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_2: The generator's second fuel, as a short code like DFO or NG; needs a lookup. Often blank in the generator table.
cols.MULTIPLE_FUELS: Whether the generator can burn more than one fuel, as Y or N.
cols.COFIRE_FUELS: Whether the generator can burn two fuels at the same time. Y or N; often blank in the generator table.
cols.SWITCH_BETWEEN_OIL_AND_NATURAL_GAS: Whether the generator can switch between oil and natural gas. Y or N; often blank in the generator table.
cols.NAMEPLATE_CAPACITY_MW: The generator's rated maximum output, in megawatts.
cols.SUMMER_CAPACITY_MW: How much power the generator can actually deliver in summer, in megawatts.
cols.WINTER_CAPACITY_MW: How much power the generator can actually deliver in winter, in megawatts.
cols.OPERATING_MONTH: The month the generator started running, as a number 1 to 12.
cols.OPERATING_YEAR: The year the generator started running, like 2011.
cols._LOADED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store it as a long number counting microseconds since 1970. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SRC_FILE: The name of the source file this row was read from, like 2___Plant_Y2024.xlsx. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.UNIT_CODE: A code tying together generators that run as one unit, like the parts of a combined-cycle plant. Mostly blank; filled only for grouped generators.
cols.DUCT_BURNERS: Whether the generator has duct burners that add heat to its exhaust: Y or N. X fills most rows and needs a lookup.
cols.CAN_BYPASS_HEAT_RECOVERY_STEAM_GENERATOR: Whether the unit can run while bypassing its heat recovery steam generator: Y or N. X fills most rows and needs a lookup.
cols.RTO_ISO_LMP_NODE_DESIGNATION: The price point name the regional grid operator uses for this generator. Mostly blank.
cols.RTO_ISO_LOCATION_DESIGNATION_FOR_REPORTI: The location name the regional grid operator uses when reporting this generator's wholesale power sales to federal regulators. Mostly blank; some rows just say none or Zonal.
cols.STATUS: The generator's operating status as a short code: OP on most rows, plus SB, OS and OA. The codes need a lookup.
cols.SYNCHRONIZED_TO_TRANSMISSION_GRID: Whether the generator is tied into the power grid: Y or N. X fills most rows and needs a lookup.
cols.ASSOCIATED_WITH_COMBINED_HEAT_AND_POWER_: Whether the generator is part of a system that makes both power and useful heat: Y or N.
cols.SECTOR: A number from 1 to 7 for the kind of owner, like a utility or a factory. The numbers need a lookup.
cols.TOPPING_OR_BOTTOMING: For heat-and-power units, whether power is made first or from leftover heat: T or B. X fills most rows and needs a lookup.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_3: The generator's third fuel, as a short code like NG, DFO or WDS. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_4: The generator's fourth fuel, as a short code like NG, DFO or WDS. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_5: The generator's fifth fuel, as a short code like NG, DFO or WDS. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.ENERGY_SOURCE_6: The generator's sixth fuel, as a short code like NG, DFO or WDS. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.STARTUP_SOURCE_1: The main fuel used to start the generator, as a short code like NG or DFO. Mostly blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.STARTUP_SOURCE_2: The second fuel used to start the generator, as a short code. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.STARTUP_SOURCE_3: The third fuel used to start the generator, as a short code. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.STARTUP_SOURCE_4: The fourth fuel used to start the generator, as a short code. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.SOLID_FUEL_GASIFICATION_SYSTEM: Whether the generator is part of a system that turns solid fuel into gas: Y or N. Almost all say N.
cols.CARBON_CAPTURE_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the generator captures carbon from its exhaust: Y or N. Very few say Y.
cols.TIME_FROM_COLD_SHUTDOWN_TO_FULL_LOAD: How long the generator takes to go from cold to full power, in bands: 10M, 1H, 12H or OVER.
cols.FLUIDIZED_BED_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses a fluidized bed boiler: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.PULVERIZED_COAL_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses a pulverized coal boiler: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.STOKER_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses a stoker boiler: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.OTHER_COMBUSTION_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses some other kind of burner: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.SUBCRITICAL_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses subcritical steam: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.SUPERCRITICAL_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses supercritical steam: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.ULTRASUPERCRITICAL_TECHNOLOGY: Whether the steam unit uses ultrasupercritical steam: Y or N. Blank for almost all generators.
cols.PLANNED_NEW_PRIME_MOVER: For generators due to be rebuilt, the new kind of machine, as a code like WT or ST. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.PLANNED_ENERGY_SOURCE_1: For generators due to be rebuilt, the new main fuel, as a code like WND or NG. Nearly always blank; the codes need a lookup.
cols.OTHER_PLANNED_MODIFICATIONS: Whether other changes are planned for the generator: Y or N. Mostly blank.
cols.UPRATE_OR_DERATE_COMPLETED_DURING_YEAR: Whether the generator's capacity was raised or cut during the year: Y or N. Almost all say N.
cols.NAMEPLATE_POWER_FACTOR: The generator's rated power factor, a number up to 1, like 0.8 or 0.9.
cols.MINIMUM_LOAD_MW: The lowest output the generator can hold steadily, in megawatts.
cols.MONTH_UPRATE_OR_DERATE_COMPLETED: The month a capacity change was finished during the year. Nearly always blank.
cols.YEAR_UPRATE_OR_DERATE_COMPLETED: The year a capacity change was finished; every filled row says 2024. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_RETIREMENT_MONTH: The month the generator is due to retire. Blank unless a retirement is planned.
cols.PLANNED_RETIREMENT_YEAR: The year the generator is due to retire, mostly 2025 onward. Blank unless a retirement is planned.
cols.TURBINES_OR_HYDROKINETIC_BUOYS: How many wind turbines or water-current buoys make up the generator. Mostly blank, and often 0.
cols.PLANNED_NET_SUMMER_CAPACITY_UPRATE_MW: Planned increase in summer output, in megawatts. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_NET_WINTER_CAPACITY_UPRATE_MW: Planned increase in winter output, in megawatts. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_UPRATE_MONTH: The month a planned output increase is due. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_UPRATE_YEAR: The year a planned output increase is due. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_NET_SUMMER_CAPACITY_DERATE_MW: Planned cut in summer output, in megawatts. Filled on only a handful of generators.
cols.PLANNED_NET_WINTER_CAPACITY_DERATE_MW: Planned cut in winter output, in megawatts. Filled on only a handful of generators.
cols.PLANNED_DERATE_MONTH: The month a planned output cut is due. Filled on only a handful of generators.
cols.PLANNED_DERATE_YEAR: The year a planned output cut is due. Filled on only a handful of generators.
cols.PLANNED_NEW_NAMEPLATE_CAPACITY_MW: The planned rated capacity after a rebuild, in megawatts. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_REPOWER_MONTH: The month a planned rebuild is due. Nearly always blank.
cols.PLANNED_REPOWER_YEAR: The year a planned rebuild is due. Nearly always blank.
cols.OTHER_MODIFICATIONS_MONTH: The month other planned changes are due. Nearly always blank.
cols.OTHER_MODIFICATIONS_YEAR: The year other planned changes are due. Nearly always blank.

cols.DATA_YEAR: The year the data covers, like 2024. One table runs into future years like 2032.
cols.UTILITY_NUMBER: The Energy Department's ID number for the utility. 99999 is a filler that lines up with the Adjustment rows, not a real utility.
cols.UTILITY_NAME: The name of the power company, utility or other plant operator, like Georgia Power Co or Walmart Stores. Some rows hold a filler like Adjustment 2024 instead of a real company.
cols.STATE: The state, usually as two letters like TX, but some tables spell out the name like Texas or United States. A few hold junk like active or a region name, and some leave it empty.
cols.OWNERSHIP_TYPE: Who owns it: for-profit, non-profit, government, cooperative and so on, with wording that differs by table. Some rows say Unavailable.
cols.NERC_REGION: The regional power-grid reliability area, as a short code like SERC or WECC.
cols._LOADED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store it as a long number counting microseconds since 1970. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.

cols.RECORD_ID: A made-up ID for each row, built from a hash. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.SUMMER_PEAK_DEMAND_MW: The utility's highest summer demand, in megawatts.
cols.WINTER_PEAK_DEMAND_MW: The utility's highest winter demand, in megawatts.
cols.NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the utility made at its own plants, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank, since most utilities make none.
cols.WHOLESALE_POWER_PURCHASES_MWH: Electricity bought wholesale from others, in megawatt-hours.
cols.EXCHANGE_ENERGY_RECEIVED_MWH: Power received in swaps with other utilities, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank, and usually 0.
cols.EXCHANGE_ENERGY_DELIVERED_MWH: Power sent out in swaps with other utilities, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank, and usually 0.
cols.NET_POWER_EXCHANGED_MWH: Swap power received minus swap power sent, in megawatt-hours. Almost always 0.
cols.WHEELED_POWER_RECEIVED_MWH: Power the utility took onto its lines to carry for others, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank, and usually 0.
cols.WHEELED_POWER_DELIVERED_MWH: Power the utility carried for others and handed off, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank, and usually 0.
cols.NET_WHEELED_POWER_MWH: Carried power received minus carried power delivered, in megawatt-hours. Almost always 0.
cols.TRANSMISSION_BY_OTHER_LOSSES_MWH: Power lost on other companies' lines, in megawatt-hours, written as a negative number. Mostly blank, and usually 0.
cols.TOTAL_SOURCES_MWH: All the electricity the utility had to work with, in megawatt-hours.
cols.SALES_TO_ULTIMATE_CUSTOMERS_MWH: Electricity sold to end users like homes and businesses, in megawatt-hours.
cols.SALES_FOR_RESALE_MWH: Electricity sold to other utilities to resell, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank.
cols.FURNISHED_WITHOUT_CHARGE_MWH: Electricity given away free, in megawatt-hours. Mostly blank.
cols.CONSUMED_BY_RESPONDENT_WITHOUT_CHARGE_MW: Electricity the utility used itself, in megawatt-hours. Blank for about half.
cols.TOTAL_ENERGY_LOSSES_MWH: Electricity lost on the way to customers, in megawatt-hours.
cols.TOTAL_DISPOSITION_MWH: Where all the electricity went, in megawatt-hours; it should equal total sources.

cols.REVENUE_FROM_DELIVERY_CUSTOMERS_THOUSAND: Money from delivering power that customers bought from someone else, in thousands of dollars. Mostly blank.

cols.REVENUE_FROM_OTHER_THOUSAND_DOLLARS: Other revenue, in thousands of dollars; can be negative.
cols.TOTAL_REVENUE_THOUSAND_DOLLARS: All revenue, in thousands of dollars.

One table uses name codes like US_SD_CLARK, and the rail casualty table leaves it mostly blank.
cols.LATITUDE: How far north the place is, usually in decimal degrees. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 481243N, and several tables leave it empty.
cols.LONGITUDE: How far east or west the place is, usually in decimal degrees; U.S. places are negative. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 0955859W, and several tables leave it empty.
cols.ADDRESS: The full address in one line of text, messy and not split into parts. Some rows hold notes instead, like UNKNOWN, Incarcerated or Moved Out of State, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.ZIP_CODE: The ZIP code, stored as text, as 5 digits or 9 with or without a dash. Some rows hold junk like XXXXX or 00000 or a 4-digit code that lost its leading zero, and two tables leave it empty.
cols.STATE_NAME: The state's full name, like Texas, in capitals in some tables. Territories like Guam show up, one table lists New York City as its own entry, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.COUNTY_NAME: The county name. Casing varies and some tables add County, Parish or the state, like Garza County, TX, so clean it before matching. One table uses Undetermined as a filler, and the rail casualty table leaves it mostly blank.
cols.CITY_NAME: The city name. Casing varies, and some rows hold fillers like Not in a City, UNKNOWN or N/A.
cols.CBSA_NAME: The name of the metro area, like Birmingham-Hoover, AL. Some tables add Metropolitan Statistical Area to the end.
cols._LOADED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store it as a long number counting microseconds since 1970. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SRC_SHA256: A fingerprint of the source file this row came from, used to spot a changed file. Some tables hold the placeholder "streamed-see-source-zip" or leave it empty. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.AQS_SITE_ID: The site's ID, built as state code, county code and site number, like 80-026-8012. Each row has its own value.
cols.SITE_NUMBER: The site's four-digit number within its county, like 0001. Only unique together with the state and county codes.
cols.DATUM: The map standard the coordinates use, like WGS84 or NAD83.
cols.ELEVATION: The site's height above sea level; the unit is not stated. 0 shows up often.
cols.LAND_USE: What the land around the site is used for, like RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL or AGRICULTURAL.
cols.LOCATION_SETTING: Whether the site is URBAN AND CENTER CITY, SUBURBAN or RURAL. Some say UNKNOWN.
cols.SITE_ESTABLISHED_DATE: The date the site opened. Many fall on January 1.
cols.SITE_CLOSED_DATE: The date the site closed. Blank for sites still open.
cols.MET_SITE_STATE_CODE: The state code of the weather station paired with this site. Almost always blank.
cols.MET_SITE_COUNTY_CODE: The county code of the paired weather station. Almost always blank.
cols.MET_SITE_SITE_NUMBER: The site number of the paired weather station. Almost always blank.
cols.MET_SITE_TYPE: The kind of weather station used for this site, like ON-SITE MET EQUIP, NWS or AIRPORT. Almost always blank.
cols.MET_SITE_DISTANCE: How far the weather station is from the site; the unit is not stated. Almost always blank.
cols.MET_SITE_DIRECTION: Which way the weather station lies from the site, like SW or NE. Almost always blank.
cols.GMT_OFFSET: The site's time zone as hours from Greenwich time, like -5 for Eastern.
cols.OWNING_AGENCY: The government agency that owns the site, like a state environment department.
cols.LOCAL_SITE_NAME: The site's local name, like a fire station or school. Mostly blank.
cols.TRIBE_NAME: The tribe whose land the site is on. Almost always blank.
cols.EXTRACTION_DATE: The date the EPA pulled this list. Every row is 2026-06-26.

ENVIRONMENT__FED_EPA_AQS_SITES.summary: Every air-quality monitoring site in the EPA's Air Quality System, open or closed, with its location, land use, setting, owning agency and open and close dates.
ENVIRONMENT__FED_EPA_AQS_SITES.row: One monitoring site: one place where air-quality monitors are or were set up.

cols.FRS_ID: The EPA's 12-digit facility registry number, starting 110. Empty in the TRI facility and Envirofacts tables.
cols.FACILITY_NAME: The name of the plant, site or building, as the agency wrote it. Generic fillers like RESIDENCE, UNKNOWN, WELL or HOME are common in some tables.
cols.STREET: The street address line, like 925 DAYNA ST or PO BOX 505. Some rows hold UNKNOWN instead.
cols.CITY: The city or town name, in capitals or mixed case, with spellings not cleaned. Some rows hold fillers like UNKNOWN or TBD, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.STATE: The state, usually as two letters like TX, but some tables spell out the name like Texas or United States. A few hold junk like active or a region name, and some leave it empty.
cols.ZIP: The ZIP code, stored as text, as 5 digits or 9 with or without a dash. Fillers like 00000, UNKNO or a lone dash show up, some codes lost a leading zero like 8721, and three tables leave it empty.
cols.COUNTY: The county, usually as a name like Harris, though some tables add the word County and the federal court tables use five-digit number codes, including 88888, which needs a lookup. The UK company table holds UK counties, and one table leaves it empty.
cols.FIPS_CODE: The county's five-digit number code, like 06037, stored as text. One table mixes in state-letter codes like TX155, and one leaves it empty.
cols.EPA_REGION: The EPA region number, 01 to 10, stored as two-digit text.
cols.LATITUDE: How far north the place is, usually in decimal degrees. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 481243N, and several tables leave it empty.
cols.LONGITUDE: How far east or west the place is, usually in decimal degrees; U.S. places are negative. Some rows hold 0 or the word None instead of a real spot, the aviation table writes it like 0955859W, and several tables leave it empty.
cols.PCT_MINORITY: The percent of people nearby, or living in the housing project, who are minorities, like 33.7. The HUD table stores it as text and has bad values like -4.
cols.POPULATION_DENSITY: People per square mile around the facility. About a third of rows are blank, and some show 0.
cols.COMPLIANCE_STATUS: The facility's current rule-breaking status in words, like No Violation Identified, Violation Identified or Significant Violation. Some rows say Inactive or Unknown.
cols.QUARTERS_WITH_NONCOMPLIANCE: How many of the last 12 quarters the facility was out of compliance, 0 to 12.
cols.TOTAL_INSPECTION_COUNT: How many inspections the facility has had.
cols.DATE_LAST_INSPECTION: The date of the facility's most recent inspection. Mostly blank in the main EPA facility table, blank in about half the penalty table.
cols.FORMAL_ACTION_COUNT: How many formal enforcement actions were taken against the facility.
cols.DATE_LAST_FORMAL_ACTION: The date of the most recent formal enforcement action. Mostly blank.
cols.TOTAL_PENALTIES: Total dollars in penalties against the facility. 0 means none.
cols.LAST_PENALTY_AMT: The dollar amount of the most recent penalty. If that case covered many facilities, this is the whole case amount.
cols.HAS_AIR_PROGRAM: True if the facility is regulated under the air pollution program.
cols.HAS_WATER_PROGRAM: True if the facility is regulated under the water pollution program.
cols.HAS_HAZWASTE_PROGRAM: True if the facility is regulated under the hazardous waste program.
cols.TRI_ON_SITE_RELEASES: Pounds of toxic chemicals the facility reported releasing on site. Almost always blank.
cols.IS_ACTIVE: True if the company, facility or mine is active now, False if not.
cols.IS_FEDERAL_FACILITY: True if the facility is run by the federal government. Every row is false in the EPA facility registry, so the flag says nothing there.
cols.IS_ON_TRIBAL_LAND: True if the facility sits on tribal land. Every row is false in the EPA facility registry, so the flag says nothing there.
cols._LOADED_AT: When this row was loaded into the warehouse. Usually a date and time, but some tables store it as a long number counting microseconds since 1970. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols._SOURCE_RUN_ID: A label for the load run that brought this row in, usually a random ID but sometimes a name like manual-1785965790 or a file name. One table can hold many run IDs. Added by your pipeline, not the source.
cols.LAST_PENALTY_AMT_ALLOCATED: This facility's share of the most recent penalty, in dollars: the case total split across the facilities it covered.
cols.LAST_PENALTY_SHARED_FACILITY_N: How many facilities shared the most recent penalty. One value, 3013568, is far too big and looks like a no-penalty filler.
cols.SIGNIFICANT_NONCOMPLIANCE_FLAG: Meant to flag serious violators, but always N here, so it tells you nothing.
cols.THREE_YR_COMPLIANCE_HISTORY: A 12-character string, one character per quarter over three years, like ____________. Underscores are clean quarters; the letters need a lookup.
cols.DAYS_SINCE_LAST_INSPECTION: Days since the facility was last inspected. Mostly blank.
cols.INFORMAL_ACTION_COUNT: How many warning letters and other informal actions the facility got. Almost always 0.
cols.PENALTY_COUNT: How many penalties the facility got. Blank on almost every row.
cols.DATE_LAST_PENALTY: When the facility's last penalty was issued. Blank on almost every row.
cols.HAS_DRINKING_WATER_PROGRAM: True if the facility is covered by drinking water rules.
cols.HAS_TOXIC_RELEASE_PROGRAM: True if the facility reports toxic chemical releases.
cols.HAS_GREENHOUSE_GAS_PROGRAM: True if the facility reports greenhouse gas emissions.
cols.TRI_TOTAL_RELEASES_TRANSFERS: Pounds of toxic chemicals the facility released or shipped off, per its toxic release report. Blank on almost every row.
cols.IS_MAJOR_FACILITY: True if the EPA counts it as a major facility.
cols.PENALTY_GAP_FLAG: True if the facility has violations but no matching penalty.

ENVIRONMENT__FED_EPA_ECHO.summary: The EPA's ECHO list of 3.1 million regulated facilities, with inspections, enforcement actions, penalties and which pollution programs cover them.
ENVIRONMENT__FED_EPA_ECHO.row: One facility: one EPA-regulated site, with its compliance and enforcement record.

cols.DATA_YEAR: The year the data covers, like 2024. One table runs into future years like 2032.
cols.PLANT_NAME: The name of the power plant.
cols.UTILITY_NAME: The name of the power company, utility or other plant operator, like Georgia Power Co or Walmart Stores. Some rows hold a filler like Adjustment 2024 instead of a real company.
cols.UTILITY_ID: The Energy Department's ID number for the utility.
cols.BALANCING_AUTHORITY_NAME: The grid operator that keeps power supply and demand matched in the area, like PJM Interconnection or Tennessee Valley Authority.
cols.BALANCING_AUTHORITY_CODE: The grid operator that balances power where the plant sits, as a short code like MISO, PJM or TVA. At least one row holds the header word BACODE instead of a code.
cols.NUMBER_OF_GENERATORS: How many generators are counted on this row.
cols.PLANT_FILE_SEQUENCE_NUMBER: EPA's row number for the plant in the eGRID file. Each plant has its own.
cols.PLANT_STATE_ABBREVIATION: The plant's state, as two letters.
cols.DOE_EIA_ORIS_PLANT_OR_FACILITY_CODE: The federal Energy Department's plant ID. Use it to join to EIA power-plant tables.
cols.PLANT_TRANSMISSION_OR_DISTRIBUTION_SYSTE: The utility that owns the power lines the plant feeds into, like Southern California Edison or Pacific Gas & Electric.
The federal ID number of the utility that owns the power lines the plant feeds into.
cols.PLANT_LEVEL_SECTOR: What kind of business runs the plant: independent power producer, electric utility, commercial or industrial, and whether it also makes useful heat.
cols.NERC_REGION_ACRONYM: The regional grid reliability region the plant sits in, as a short code like WECC or SERC.
cols.EGRID_SUBREGION_ACRONYM: EPA's grid subregion code for the plant, like CAMX. The full name is in the subregion name column.
cols.EGRID_SUBREGION_NAME: EPA's grid subregion name for the plant, like WECC California or MRO West.
cols.PLANT_ASSOCIATED_ISO_RTO_TERRITORY: The grid operator whose market the plant sells into, like MISO, PJM or CAISO. Blank for about a third of plants.
cols.PLANT_FIPS_STATE_CODE: The plant's state as a two-digit federal code, like 06 for California.
cols.PLANT_FIPS_COUNTY_CODE: The plant's county as a three-digit federal code. It only means something together with the state code.
cols.PLANT_COUNTY_NAME: The county the plant is in, by name.
cols.CAMD_PROGRAM_FLAG: Says Yes when the plant reports to EPA's smokestack monitoring programs. Blank for most plants, and one stray row holds the header text CAMDFLAG.
cols.NUMBER_OF_UNITS: How many generating units the plant has. Most have just one.
cols.PLANT_PRIMARY_FUEL: The plant's main fuel as a short code, like SUN, NG, WAT or WND. The plain-word category is in the fuel category column.
cols.PLANT_PRIMARY_FUEL_CATEGORY: The plant's main fuel in plain words: solar, gas, hydro, wind, oil, biomass and so on. Solar is the most common.
cols.FLAG_INDICATING_IF_THE_PLANT_BURNED_OR_G: Says Yes when the plant burned any coal in 2022. Blank for almost every plant, and one stray row holds the header text COALFLAG.
cols.PLANT_CAPACITY_FACTOR: How hard the plant ran in 2022, as a share of what it could make running flat out all year, from 0 to 1. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_NAMEPLATE_CAPACITY_MW: The most power the plant is built to make, in megawatts. Stored as text.
cols.NONBASELOAD_FACTOR: EPA's estimate of how much of the plant's output comes at peak times rather than around the clock, from 0 to 1. Blank for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.BIOGAS_BIOMASS_PLANT_ADJUSTMENT_FLAG: Says Yes when EPA adjusted the plant's emissions because it burns biogas or biomass. Blank for most plants, and one stray row holds the header text RMBMFLAG.
cols.COMBINED_HEAT_AND_POWER_CHP_PLANT_ADJUST: Says Yes when the plant makes both power and useful heat, so EPA split its emissions between the two. Blank for most plants, and one stray row holds the header text CHPFLAG.
cols.CHP_PLANT_USEFUL_THERMAL_OUTPUT_MMBTU: For plants that make both power and heat: how much useful heat they made, in million BTU. Blank for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.CHP_PLANT_POWER_TO_HEAT_RATIO: For plants that make both power and heat: power made divided by heat made. Blank for most plants.
cols.CHP_PLANT_ELECTRIC_ALLOCATION_FACTOR: For plants that make both power and heat: the share of emissions EPA charged to the electricity, from 0 to 1. Blank for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_PUMPED_STORAGE_FLAG: Says Yes when the plant is a pumped-storage hydro plant. Blank for almost all plants, and one stray row holds the header text PSFLAG.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HEAT_INPUT_FROM_COMBUSTION_: How much fuel energy the plant burned in 2022, in million BTU. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_HEAT_INPUT_FROM_COMBU: How much fuel energy the plant burned during the summer ozone season, in million BTU. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_TOTAL_ANNUAL_HEAT_INPUT_MMBTU: How much total energy the plant took in, from fuel, sun, wind or water, in 2022, in million BTU.
cols.PLANT_TOTAL_OZONE_SEASON_HEAT_INPUT_MMBT: How much total energy the plant took in, from fuel, sun, wind or water, during the summer ozone season, in million BTU.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made during the summer ozone season, after its own use, in megawatt-hours.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_EMISSIONS_TONS: How much nitrogen oxides the plant put out in 2022, in tons. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_EMISSIONS_TONS: How much nitrogen oxides the plant put out during the summer ozone season, in tons. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_EMISSIONS_TONS: How much sulfur dioxide the plant put out in 2022, in tons. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EMISSIONS_TONS: How much carbon dioxide the plant put out in 2022, in tons. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_EMISSIONS_LBS: How much methane the plant put out in 2022, in pounds. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_EMISSIONS_LBS: How much nitrous oxide the plant put out in 2022, in pounds. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EQUIVALENT_EMISSIONS_TO: How much greenhouse gas, counted as carbon dioxide, the plant put out in 2022, in tons. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HG_EMISSIONS_LBS: Meant to hold the plant's mercury emissions. Empty in practice: the only value is a stray header code, PLHGAN.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_R: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMIS: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity during the summer ozone season. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_R: Pounds of sulfur dioxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_R: Pounds of carbon dioxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_R: Pounds of methane the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_: Pounds of nitrous oxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EQUIVALENT_TOTAL_OUTPUT: Pounds of greenhouse gas, counted as carbon dioxide, the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HG_TOTAL_OUTPUT_EMISSION_RA: Meant to hold the plant's mercury emission rate. Empty in practice: the only value is a stray header code, PLHGRTA.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB_: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_INPUT_EMISSION_RA: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned during the summer ozone season. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB_: Pounds of sulfur dioxide the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB_: Pounds of carbon dioxide the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB_: Pounds of methane the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB: Pounds of nitrous oxide the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EQUIVALENT_INPUT_EMISSI: Pounds of greenhouse gas, counted as carbon dioxide, the plant put out per million BTU of fuel burned in 2022. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HG_INPUT_EMISSION_RATE_LB_M: Meant to hold the plant's mercury emission rate. Empty in practice: the only value is a stray header code, PLHGRA.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMISS: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT: Pounds of nitrogen oxides the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity during the summer ozone season, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMISS: Pounds of sulfur dioxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMISS: Pounds of carbon dioxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMISS: Pounds of methane the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMIS: Pounds of nitrous oxide the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EQUIVALENT_COMBUSTION_O: Pounds of greenhouse gas, counted as carbon dioxide, the plant put out per megawatt-hour of electricity in 2022, counting only power made by burning fuel. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HG_COMBUSTION_OUTPUT_EMISSI: Meant to hold the plant's mercury emission rate. Empty in practice: the only value is a stray header code, PLHGCRT.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_NOX_EMISSIONS_TO: How much nitrogen oxides the plant put out in 2022, in tons, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_EMISSI: How much nitrogen oxides the plant put out during the summer ozone season, in tons, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_SO2_EMISSIONS_TO: How much sulfur dioxide the plant put out in 2022, in tons, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_CO2_EMISSIONS_TO: How much carbon dioxide the plant put out in 2022, in tons, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_CH4_EMISSIONS_LB: How much methane the plant put out in 2022, in pounds, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_N2_O_EMISSIONS_L: How much nitrous oxide the plant put out in 2022, in pounds, before EPA adjustments for heat and biomass. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_HG_EMISSIONS_LBS: Meant to hold the plant's mercury emissions, before EPA adjustments. Empty in practice: the only value is a stray header code, UNHG.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_HEAT_INPUT_FROM_: How much fuel energy the plant burned in 2022, in million BTU, before EPA adjustments. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_OZONE_SEASON_HEAT_INPUT: How much fuel energy the plant burned during the summer ozone season, in million BTU, before EPA adjustments. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_TOTAL_ANNUAL_HEAT_INPUT: How much total energy the plant took in, from fuel, sun, wind or water, in 2022, in million BTU, before EPA adjustments.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_TOTAL_OZONE_SEASON_HEAT: How much total energy the plant took in, from fuel, sun, wind or water, during the summer ozone season, in million BTU, before EPA adjustments.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_NOX_EMISSIONS_SO: Where the plant's nitrogen oxides number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_EMISSI: Where the plant's nitrogen oxides number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_SO2_EMISSIONS_SO: Where the plant's sulfur dioxide number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_CO2_EMISSIONS_SO: Where the plant's carbon dioxide number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_CH4_EMISSIONS_SO: Where the plant's methane number came from. Only EIA fuel reports appear. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_N2_O_EMISSIONS_S: Where the plant's nitrous oxide number came from. Only EIA fuel reports appear. Blank for most plants.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_HG_EMISSIONS_SOU: Meant to say where the mercury number came from. Every plant holds just a -- placeholder, so it is empty in practice.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_ANNUAL_HEAT_INPUT_SOURC: Where the plant's fuel number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both.
cols.PLANT_UNADJUSTED_OZONE_SEASON_HEAT_INPUT: Where the plant's fuel number came from: EIA fuel reports, EPA smokestack monitors, or both.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS_TONS: The part of the plant's nitrogen oxides in 2022 that came from burning biomass, in tons. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS: The part of the plant's nitrogen oxides during the summer ozone season that came from burning biomass, in tons. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS_TONS: The part of the plant's sulfur dioxide in 2022 that came from burning biomass, in tons. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS_TONS: The part of the plant's carbon dioxide in 2022 that came from burning biomass, in tons. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS_LBS: The part of the plant's methane in 2022 that came from burning biomass, in pounds. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_BIOMASS_EMISSIONS_LBS: The part of the plant's nitrous oxide in 2022 that came from burning biomass, in pounds. Blank for plants that burn no biomass, which is almost all of them. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_COMBUSTION_HEAT_INPUT_CHP_ADJUSTME: How much fuel burned in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in million BTU. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_COMBUSTION_ANNUAL_OZONE_SEASON_HEA: How much fuel burned during the summer ozone season EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in million BTU. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NOX_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJUSTMEN: How much nitrogen oxides in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in tons. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OZONE_SEASON_NOX_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJ: How much nitrogen oxides during the summer ozone season EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in tons. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SO2_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJUSTMEN: How much sulfur dioxide in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in tons. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CO2_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJUSTMEN: How much carbon dioxide in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in tons. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_CH4_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJUSTMEN: How much methane in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in pounds. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_N2_O_EMISSIONS_CHP_ADJUSTME: How much nitrous oxide in 2022 EPA took off the plant's total because it went to making heat, not power, in pounds. Blank except for plants that make both power and heat. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_NOMINAL_HEAT_RATE_BTU_KWH: How much fuel energy the plant burns per kilowatt-hour it makes, in BTU. Lower means more efficient. Blank for most plants, mainly the ones that burn nothing.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_COAL_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from coal in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_OIL_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from oil in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_GAS_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from gas in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_NUCLEAR_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from nuclear in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_HYDRO_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from hydro in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_BIOMASS_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from biomass in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_WIND_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from wind in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_SOLAR_NET_GENERATION_MWH: Electricity the plant made from solar in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_GEOTHERMAL_NET_GENERATION_M: Electricity the plant made from geothermal in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_OTHER_FOSSIL_NET_GENERATION: Electricity the plant made from other fossil in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_OTHER_UNKNOWN_PURCHASED_FUE: Electricity the plant made in 2022 from other, unknown or bought fuel, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants, and some values are negative.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_TOTAL_NONRENEWABLES_NET_GEN: Electricity the plant made from total nonrenewables in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_TOTAL_RENEWABLES_NET_GENERA: Electricity the plant made from total renewables in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_TOTAL_NONHYDRO_RENEWABLES_N: Electricity the plant made from total nonhydro renewables in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_TOTAL_COMBUSTION_NET_GENERA: Electricity the plant made from total combustion in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours. Zero for most plants.
cols.PLANT_ANNUAL_TOTAL_NONCOMBUSTION_NET_GEN: Electricity the plant made from total noncombustion in 2022, after its own use, in megawatt-hours.
cols.PLANT_COAL_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_M: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from coal, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OIL_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_MI: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from oil, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_GAS_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_MI: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from gas, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_NUCLEAR_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURC: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from nuclear, from 0 to 1. Zero for almost every plant. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_HYDRO_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from hydro, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_BIOMASS_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURC: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from biomass, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_WIND_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_M: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from wind, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_SOLAR_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESOURCE_: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from solar, from 0 to 1. Zero or 1 for nearly every plant. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_GEOTHERMAL_GENERATION_PERCENT_RESO: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from geothermal, from 0 to 1. Zero for almost every plant. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OTHER_FOSSIL_GENERATION_PERCENT_RE: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from other fossil fuels, from 0 to 1. Zero for almost every plant. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_OTHER_UNKNOWN_PURCHASED_FUEL_GENER: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from other, unknown or bought fuel, from 0 to 1. Zero for almost every plant. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_TOTAL_NONRENEWABLES_GENERATION_PER: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from nonrenewable sources, from 0 to 1. Zero for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_TOTAL_RENEWABLES_GENERATION_PERCEN: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from renewable sources, from 0 to 1. 1 for most plants. Stored as text.
cols.PLANT_TOTAL_NONHYDRO_RENEWABLES_GENERATI: The share of the plant's 2022 electricity that came from renewable sources other than hydro, from 0 to 1. 1 for most plants. Stored as text.
